# The demo content package cjw_multisite_democontent

`cjw_multisite_democontent` holds the content of the CJW starter site. It is a package of type `contentobject` with
`install_type="install"`, required by [cjw_multisite](README.md). Next to what the kernel's package handlers install
(classes and objects), it carries four side files that only the site package's installer reads. This page explains
each part, for developers who change the content or build a package like it.

## The package in short

From `package.xml`:

```text
The content of the CJW Multisite starter site (design starter of the cjw_themes_jumper extension): pages,
articles, news, galleries, banners, forms and images, in English and German, with the content classes it uses.
The image and file contents are read from extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/content-images and content-files.
```

| Part | Count | Installed by |
|---|---|---|
| `<provide type="ezcontentclass">` entries and `ezcontentclass` install items | 40 | the kernel's content class handler |
| Object files listed in `ezcontentobject/contentobjects.xml` | 138 | the kernel's content object handler |
| `<simple-file>` entries | 158 | the kernel, after the installer linked them in |
| Side files | 4 | the site package's installer (`cjw-starter-install.php`) |

Every reference between objects, nodes, tags and layouts uses remote ids, never ids of another installation:
objects are `cjw-starter-o-<id>`, nodes `cjw-starter-n-<id>`, tags `cjw-starter-t-<id>`. The starter root is
`cjw-starter-n-root` (an object named "Starter", placed below the content root), the start page
`cjw-starter-n-779`.

## The content classes

The 40 classes, all with an `ezcontentclass` install item:

| Group | Classes |
|---|---|
| `ng_*` pages and parts (31) | `ng_accordion_item`, `ng_article`, `ng_audio`, `ng_banner`, `ng_blog_post`, `ng_category`, `ng_component_about`, `ng_component_features`, `ng_component_hero`, `ng_component_lead`, `ng_component_logos`, `ng_component_quote`, `ng_contact_form`, `ng_container`, `ng_cookie_policy`, `ng_frontpage`, `ng_gallery`, `ng_htmlbox`, `ng_job_application_form`, `ng_job_position`, `ng_landing_page`, `ng_lead_form`, `ng_logo`, `ng_menu_item`, `ng_news`, `ng_person`, `ng_recipe`, `ng_shortcut`, `ng_site_info`, `ng_topic`, `ng_video` |
| Forms and folders (3) | `cjw_feedback_form`, `cjw_folder_management`, `ng_feedback_form` |
| The TMV event feed (6) | `tmv_container`, `tmv_container_categories`, `tmv_categorie`, `tmv_date`, `tmv_event`, `tmv_image` |

The classes `image` and `file` that 63 of the objects use come from the required `sevenx_classes`.

## The content objects

`contentobjects.xml` lists the 138 object files in install order, names one top node (`cjw-starter-n-root`, "Starter")
and the siteaccesses `site` and `admin`. `cjw-starter-import.json` lists 137 of the objects with class, languages and
node remote id; by class:

| Class | Objects | Class | Objects |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | 61 | `ng_article` | 23 |
| `ng_news` | 9 | `ng_banner` | 6 |
| `ng_container`, `ng_gallery`, `ng_landing_page`, `ng_shortcut` | 5 each | `file`, `ng_category`, `ng_htmlbox` | 2 each |
| `cjw_feedback_form`, `cjw_folder_management`, `ng_audio`, `ng_blog_post`, `ng_cookie_policy`, `ng_feedback_form`, `ng_frontpage`, `ng_recipe`, `ng_site_info`, `ng_video`, `tmv_container`, `tmv_container_categories` | 1 each | | |

Languages: 111 objects are in `ger-DE` only, 22 in `eng-US` only and 4 in both. Each object file keeps its original
publish and modify times (`ezremote:published`, `ezremote:modified`), which the installer restores so lists sorted by
date come out as on the source site.

## Simple files that point into the extension

A `<simple-file>` entry of this package has, besides the usual `key`, `original-path` and `package-path`, an
`extension-path` attribute:

```xml
<simple-file key="..." original-path="var/site/storage/images/..."
             package-path="simplefiles/2559185f95d63921.jpg"
             extension-path="extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/content-images/2559185f95d63921.jpg"/>
```

The archive has no `simplefiles/` folder. Before the packages are installed, `cjwLinkStarterFilesFromExtension()`
creates a symbolic link in the package's `simplefiles/` for every entry (a copy where links cannot be made), so the
kernel finds each file where `eZPackage::simpleFilePath()` expects it. After the install,
`cjwUnlinkStarterFilesFromExtension()` removes those links again (copies stay). 155 entries point into
`share/content-images/`, 3 into `share/content-files/`, 77 distinct files in all.

## cjw-class-additions.xml

Eighteen attributes in nine classes that the starter content needs on top of the `ng_*` classes of `sevenx_classes`:

| Class | Attributes (datatype) |
|---|---|
| `ng_article` | `additional_image`, `icon_title` (`ezimage`) |
| `ng_banner` | `header_text` (`ezxmltext`) |
| `ng_category` | `image` (`ezimage`) |
| `ng_container` | `full_intro`, `teaser_intro` (`ezxmltext`), `image` (`ezimage`), `short_title` (`ezstring`) |
| `ng_frontpage` | `teaser_title` (`ezstring`), `teaser_intro`, `full_intro` (`ezxmltext`), `image` (`ezimage`), `tags` (`eztags`) |
| `ng_gallery` | `column_count` (`ezinteger`) |
| `ng_landing_page` | `full_intro` (`ezxmltext`), `image` (`ezimage`) |
| `ng_news` | `location` (`ezgmaplocation`) |
| `ng_shortcut` | `icon_title` (`ezimage`) |

`cjwEnsureStarterClassAdditions()` adds an attribute only when the class has none of that identifier: never
required, after the last attribute, with an empty value in every existing object. The class definitions of this
package carry them already, so on a new installation all are reported as present; an installation whose classes came
from elsewhere gets what is missing. An existing attribute is never changed; one with another datatype is reported.

## cjw-starter-import.json

The import sidecar. Its keys:

| Key | Content | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | The site and time of the snapshot the content was taken from | information only |
| `root_node_remote_id`, `home_node_remote_id` | `cjw-starter-n-root`, `cjw-starter-n-779` | information; the installer has them as constants |
| `hidden_node_remote_ids` | `cjw-starter-n-807`, the configuration folder (site info, cookie policy, header links) | `cjwHideStarterNodes()` |
| `tags` | 5 tags with parent, keyword, remote id and locale | `cjwFixStarterTags()` |
| `link_resolution` | How `ngenhancedlink` values with a `remote_id` get the installed object's `id` | `cjwResolveStarterLinks()` |
| `objects` | 137 objects with remote id, class, languages, node remote id and MD5 | checks |
| `files` | 158 simple-file keys with `extension-path` and SHA-1 | checks |

The tags are made below a tag "Starter" (`cjw-starter-t-root`); the tag ids in the object files are those of the
source site and are not used.

## cjw-explayouts.json

The layouts of the starter, as rows for the explayouts tables:

```json
{ "band": 900000, "node_references": { ... }, "rows": { "explayouts_layout": [ ... ], ... } }
```

| Table | Rows | Table | Rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `explayouts_layout` | 23 (6 shared) | `explayouts_collection` | 59 |
| `explayouts_zone` | 113 | `explayouts_collection_item` | 5 |
| `explayouts_block` | 269 | `explayouts_collection_query` | 42 |
| `explayouts_block_parameter` | 2,043 | `explayouts_rule` | 11 |
| `explayouts_rule_target` | 11 (7 subtree, 4 node) | `explayouts_rule_condition` | 19 (11 siteaccess, 8 class) |

All ids are 900000 or higher (the band). `node_references` names, per row of `explayouts_collection_item`,
`explayouts_collection_query` and `explayouts_rule_target`, the field that holds a node id and the node's remote id.
`cjwSeedStarterLayouts()` replaces those with the node ids of the new installation, sets every siteaccess condition to
the installation's user siteaccesses, deletes the rows of the band that exist, inserts the file's rows and clears the
layout resolver cache. Nothing below the band is touched.

> **Note**
> Unlike `sevenx_multisite`, whose layout rows come from the `share/*.dba` files of extensions, the starter's layouts
> travel inside the content package. See [sevenx_multisite and cjw_multisite compared](sevenx-and-cjw-compared.md).

## cjw-paths.json

The URL path of every node on the source site, per language view: 138 entries, 137 keyed by node remote id and `_root`
for the starter root itself. An entry:

```json
"cjw-starter-n-176": { "node": 176, "class": "ng_landing_page", "languages": ["eng-US","ger-DE"],
                       "hidden": 0, "ger": "showcase", "name_ger": "Showcase", "eng": "showcase", "name_eng": "Showcase" }
```

`cjwApplyStarterPaths()` walks the tree top-down and makes each node's last path segment the wanted one, so the
installed site answers the same addresses as the source site. See [The installer scripts](the-installer-scripts.md).
